source_file: Splits file based on Tuple/Split file based on a Tuple with N numbers.sas
notes: The %Interv_logic macro (byte-identical to source) computes START/END row-index pairs that split a table into N pieces given a tuple of desired row counts, e.g. (20,34,56) covering a 110-row table. The source file defines the macro but never calls it (only a header comment describes the intended usage); wrote a caller using that exact example, plus a small DATA step + PROC PRINT to make the resulting split boundaries observable.
